### Architecture change?

- [ ] Ordinary change to the current architecture.

For a major replacement of the historical Reasonix core, add `reasonix-evolution.json`.
If `balance-apk-v1` is preserved, provide its black-box contract probe.

Do not modify the root trusted automation (`.github/`, `automation/`, `.reasonix/governance/`) in an ordinary community PR. Those paths are intentionally excluded from unattended auto-merge.
